title: Ox Passion Senorita Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Senorita is a bright and uplifting blend of Pineapple, Pink Grapefruit, and Orange. The tropical sweetness of pineapple sets the stage, followed by the bold citrus tang of pink grapefruit, while a burst of juicy orange rounds out the exhale with a refreshing, zesty finish. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with layered, well-defined flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers fast nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
